worldcombat.skill.sludgebomb.summary: The user loads sludge into a shell and throws it to the target's feet, where it skitters and hisses on a lit fuse; when the fuse burns out the ring around it is hurt, shoved back and may be poisoned. A foe can step out before it blows. Sealed style is wider and more poisonous at the cost of a lighter blast and a longer fuse.
worldcombat.skill.sludgebomb.use.0: Drop a delayed bomb into a group and scatter it
worldcombat.skill.sludgebomb.use.1: Seal off a patch of the foe's path
worldcombat.skill.sludgebomb.use.2: Poison everyone around the blast at once
worldcombat.skill.sludgebomb.description: When the fuse burns out, each foe within %2$s blocks of the blast takes about %1$s damage. The target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
The bomb has a %1$s s fuse after it lands; foes can walk out in that time. The blast shoves them %2$s blocks away from its centre.
Those splashed have a %1$s poison chance; the poison lasts %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sludgebomb.sealed.on: Sealed style on: ×1.3 blast radius, a stronger shove, a longer fuse and ×1.2 poison chance, at ×0.9 blast damage.
worldcombat.skill.sludgebomb.sealed.off: Sealed style off (Dense shell): ×1.12 blast damage, a shorter fuse and a tighter radius.
worldcombat.skill.sludgebomb.timing: Cast on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.sludgebomb.growth.0: At level %1$s the blast rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks wide.
worldcombat.skill.sludgebomb.growth.1: At level %1$s the blast rises to %2$s power and the poison chance to %3$s.
On: ×1.3 blast radius, a stronger shove, a longer fuse and ×1.2 poison chance, at ×0.9 blast damage, for scattering a group. Off: one denser, harder shell (×1.12 damage) with a shorter fuse and a tighter radius, for hitting a single target.
Only foes within this distance become bombing candidates; the shared approach logic then walks the companion into throw range. Higher starts the chase earlier.
On, the companion prefers a bomb when another foe stands within 3.5 blocks of the target, catching the group; off keeps the normal attack order.
On, the companion may leave its post to bomb a target; off restricts it to throws it can make from where it stands.
